learnings: Ktor 3.5.0 works cleanly with Kotlin 2.4.0 when using Ktor's Jackson 2.21.3 dependency set instead of pinning an older jackson-module-kotlin version.
Specmatic Enterprise 1.18.0 accepts swaggerUrl for the system under test configuration; unsupported filter shapes were removed from specmatic.yaml.
Dependency mocks are started with specmatic/enterprise:1.18.0 mock --config specmatic.yaml; the Kafka mock uses BROKER_HOST=localhost because 0.0.0.0 is invalid for advertised listeners.
Docker-mounted Specmatic git caches require safe.directory environment configuration for the cloned contract repository.
The none and positiveOnly resiliency modes had zero contract failures but did not meet the enforced 70% governance coverage threshold; the shipped all mode passes with 92% API coverage.
